title: anthoxanthum odoratum subsp. furumii
intro: Anthoxanthum odoratum subsp. furumii, commonly known as sweet vernal grass or meadow sweet, is a type of flowering plant belonging to the grass family (Poaceae). It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including its ability to help alleviate respiratory issues and promote relaxation. The health benefits of this plant include its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can aid in soothing skin irritations and wound healing. The bioactive constituents of sweet vernal grass include flavonoids, coumarins, and other phenolic compounds that contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as antispasmodic and expectorant properties.
